mcqs.question: How do you plan for people with very different experience?

options.text: I prepare a basic task that stands on its own and an extension that adds responsibility. Nobody has to leave the group to find an appropriate challenge.
I ask them to notice what helps the table move together. Expertise becomes generous when it creates room instead of setting the pace.
I would let participants decide when the extension becomes useful. That choice may show me forms of difficulty I did not anticipate.
I would reject the approach described here and keep the existing routine unchanged.

mcqs.rationale: The correct option reproduces the answer to this held-out question; the alternatives come from related answers or reverse its intent.
